fast_mode.label: Fast Mode
fast_mode.description: Runs the arm as fast as it can. Moves may cut corners, so use it for jogging and repositioning, not for a job.

straight_mode.label: Straight Mode
straight_mode.description: Keeps every move a straight line (M2000 line mode). Use it for drawing, laser and 3D printing, where the tool must follow the path exactly.
